item.title: 4 men convicted in Hancock County home invasion case
item.description: Two men from Indianapolis and two men from Gary were found guilty of burglary and conspiracy to commit burglary in a home invasion in May 2024 in western Hancock County, where a gunshot was fired. Two of the men were also found to be habitual offenders.

item.title: California battered by powerful winter storm, flash floods and mudslides loom
item.description: California was hit by a powerful winter storm on Monday, bringing heavy snow, high winds, and thunderstorms, causing flash flood warnings, road closures, and evacuations in some areas, while ski resorts celebrated the snowfall.

item.title: Police see ‘substance’ thrown from truck during high-speed chase on I-69
item.description: Two people were arrested and charged with resisting law enforcement, possession of meth, and obstruction of justice after a 89-mile vehicle pursuit in Monroe County, Indiana, during which they threw out a "substance" from the truck.

item.title: Head-on crash in Greenfield kills driver, injures 6; 1 airlifted with serious injuries
item.description: One person was killed and four children were taken to the hospital with injuries after a head-on crash involving two vehicles in Greenfield, Indiana, on Saturday.

item.title: Indiana House committee endorses township consolidation plan
item.description: An Indiana House committee has endorsed a plan to consolidate hundreds of Indiana's 1,000+ township governments, which would require townships with low performance evaluations to merge with other townships and allow city governments to take over township functions when the township is located mostly within the city limits.

item.title: How common are ‘slight’ risks of severe storms in February for central Indiana?
item.description: Central Indiana is under a slight risk of severe storms on Thursday, Feb. 19, 2026, with scattered severe storms possible.

item.title: Record highs likely Wednesday, severe storm potential Thursday | Feb. 17, 2026
item.description: Central Indiana is expecting a warm Wednesday with record highs likely, but Thursday could bring strong to severe storms with isolated showers and thunderstorms possible.

item.title: Mark Cuban criticizes NBA’s stance on tanking and draft integrity
item.description: Mark Cuban criticized the NBA for punishing teams -- including the Indiana Pacers -- that appear to be losing on purpose to improve their draft picks, and suggested that the league focus more on fan experience than tanking.

item.title: Former teacher recalls dream to serve of slain Beech Grove police officer
item.description: Officer Brian Elliott of the Beech Grove Police Department was fatally shot while responding to a domestic disturbance call. His former elementary school teacher, Tonya Reid, who is now an assistant principal, expressed her sadness and remembered Elliott as a kind and intelligent boy who always wanted to be a police officer.

item.title: Trooper’s report reveals what led to Officer Brian Elliott’s fatal shooting
item.description: An Indiana State Police trooper reports on what led to the fatal shooting of Officer Brian Elliott and the injury of another Beech Grove Police Department officer while responding to a domestic call involving Kenneth T. Johnson, who was arrested after allegedly firing a handgun through a door.
